edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial mint in the constructor.
onlyOwner gate compares owner() to msg.sender before enabling trading.
onlyOwner gate on removeLimits depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gate on swap threshold update depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gate on max-transaction exemption.
onlyOwner gate on buy fee update.
onlyOwner gate on sell fee update.
onlyOwner gate on fee exemption toggling.
onlyOwner gate on AMM pair configuration.
onlyOwner gate on marketing wallet update.
onlyOwner gate on dev wallet update.
msg.sender is the implicit transfer caller mapped to from in public transfer paths.
onlyOwner gate on auto LP burn settings.
onlyOwner gate on manual LP burn.
tx.origin keys the per-block anti-bot delay mapping, giving origin-based gating.
tx.origin indexes _holderLastTransferTimestamp to enforce one purchase per block.
enableTrading records block.timestamp as lastLpBurnTime.
LP burn eligibility compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
auto burn resets lastLpBurnTime to block.timestamp.
manual burn cooldown and timestamp update depend on block.timestamp.

enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading initializes lastLpBurnTime.
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect to false.
disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled to false.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes the swap threshold.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the exemption mapping.
updateSwapEnabled writes swapEnabled.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exemption mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the AMM pair mapping.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
updateDevWallet writes devWallet.
isExcludedFromFees reads the fee exemption mapping.
owner() returns the stored _owner.
_transfer moves balances via super._transfer.
_transfer reads limitsInEffect to gate anti-whale checks.
_transfer reads tradingActive to block early transfers.
_transfer reads transferDelayEnabled to apply launch delay.
_transfer reads and writes the per-origin transfer-block mapping.
_transfer consults automatedMarketMakerPairs to detect buys/sells.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount.
_transfer enforces maxWallet.
_transfer reads max-transaction exemptions.
_transfer reads fee exemption status.
_transfer reads and sets the swapping guard.
_transfer compares contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before swapBack.
_transfer checks lpBurnEnabled for auto burn.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency.
_transfer reads lastLpBurnTime for LP burn eligibility.
_transfer uses buyTotalFees to compute buy fees.
_transfer divides fee shares by sellTotalFees after multiplication.
_transfer accumulates tokensForMarketing.
_transfer accumulates tokensForLiquidity.
_transfer accumulates tokensForDev.
_transfer calls swapBack when the swap conditions hold.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when LP burn is due.
contractTokenBalance local is derived inside _transfer.
fees local is computed inside _transfer.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router to build path and swap.
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap external call.
The router swap deadline is block.timestamp.
addLiquidity reads uniswapV2Router to add liquidity.
addLiquidity sends LP tokens to deadAddress.
addLiquidity performs the router addLiquidityETH external call with ETH value.
The addLiquidityETH deadline is block.timestamp.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForMarketing.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForDev.
swapBack caps contract balance using swapTokensAtAmount.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity share is nonzero.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet via low-level call before finishing distribution.
swapBack forwards the remaining ETH balance to marketingWallet via low-level call.
ethBalance - ethForMarketing - ethForDev computes ethForLiquidity and can underflow conceptually.
A malicious devWallet can reenter _transfer/swapBack through token transfers while swapping distribution is in progress.
A malicious marketingWallet can reenter the transfer flow before the distribution completes.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastLpBurnTime.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads percentForLPBurn to size the burn.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads pair balance and transfers from the pair.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens transfers LP tokens to deadAddress.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens performs the external pair.sync() call.
amountToBurn is computed as liquidityPairBalance * percentForLPBurn / 10000.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens updates lastManualLpBurnTime.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens enforces manualBurnFrequency cooldown.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads pair balance and transfers from the pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens performs the external pair.sync() call.
from parameter drives limit checks, fee logic and super._transfer.
to parameter drives AMM detection and final transfer.
amount feeds fee multiplication/division and subtraction.
account parameter indexes the fee exemption mapping.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as ETH value to addLiquidityETH.
percent parameter bounds and sizes the manual LP burn.
newNum parameter is validated and written as maxTransactionAmount.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only meaningful within the _transfer fee/limit logic.
Parameter to is only meaningful within the _transfer AMM/limit logic.
Parameter amount is only meaningful within the _transfer fee computation.
Parameter account is used solely to index the fee exemption mapping.
Parameter tokenAmount is approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
Parameter ethAmount is the ETH value sent to the router by addLiquidity.
Parameter percent only bounds and sizes the manual burn calculation.
Parameter newNum is validated and stored as maxTransactionAmount.
Local senderBalance is a cached balance used only inside the transfer flow.
Local currentAllowance is used only inside the transferFrom/decreaseAllowance flow.
Local contractTokenBalance is used only to decide whether swapBack runs.
Local fees is computed and consumed only within _transfer.
Local liquidityTokens is computed only within swapBack.
Local amountToSwapForETH is used only for the swapBack swap amount.
Local ethBalance tracks swap proceeds used only in swapBack distribution.
Local amountToBurn is computed only for the LP burn transfer.
Local totalTokensToSwap aggregates pending fee allocations in swapBack.
Local initialETHBalance is used only to measure ETH gained during swapBack.
